records.en: This is like those boat docks you see at a lake.

records.en: But if we get caught in the current we might not be able to get back...

records.en: If we swim really hard, we might be able to escape, you know?

records.jp: いや、見るからに無理だからやめとく
records.en_original: I don't need to try to know that's impossible.
records.en: I don't need to try to know that's impossible.

records.en: Hmm, maybe a sports drink? I'm pretty sweaty...^00Ah, but tea sounds good too...

records.jp: （……思ったより時間かかりそうだな。^00　待ってあげよう）

records.en: (...This might take longer than I thought.^00I'll give her some time.)

records.en: I'm a little thirsty.

records.en: There's always water in the fridge,^00why don't you bring some?

records.en_original: Ooh, someone's well-prepared. I appreciate it.
records.en: Ooh, someone's well-prepared.^00I appreciate it.

records.en: Oh, we had this manga at my school too.^00It was so popular some of the volumes were always missing.

records.jp: あー、あるある。次の巻が読みたいのに^00なかなか返って来なかったりしてね
records.en_original: Ahh, yeah. It sucks when you want to read the next volume and it's checked out.
records.en: Ahh, yeah. It sucks when you want to read^00the next volume and it's checked out.

records.jp: かといって自分で買うほどでもなくて、^00結局読むの諦めちゃうんだよね……
records.en_original: But I never wanted to buy it myself. In the end, I just gave up on it...
records.en: But I never wanted to buy it myself.^00In the end, I just gave up on it...

records.jp: う、熱気がこもってて暑い……
records.en_original: Ugh, it's so hot and stuffy in here...
records.en: Ugh, it's so hot and stuffy in here...

records.jp: 窓開けて換気しよっか……
records.en_original: Let's open the windows and let some air in.
records.en: Let's open the windows and let some air in.

records.jp: うん、そうしよ……。^00このまま運動したら倒れちゃうよ
records.en_original: Yeah, good idea... If we exercised in here like this, we'd get heatstroke.
records.en: Yeah, good idea...^00If we exercised in here like this, we'd get heatstroke.

records.en: Oh no.^00I left the towel I used yesterday out...

records.en: You should hurry up and wash it.^00You don't want to let it sit in this heat.

records.jp: 忘れないうちに洗わなきゃ……
records.en_original: I better wash it before I forget...
records.en: I better wash it before I forget...

records.jp: この学校、教室少なくない？^00普通こんなもんだっけ
records.en_original: Is it just me, or do normal schools have more classrooms than this?
records.en: Is it just me, or do normal schools have^00more classrooms than this?

records.jp: 言われてみれば少ない気もするけど……。^00でも丁度いい広さだと思う。この人数なら
records.en_original: Maybe, now that you mention it. But it feels like just the right size for us.
records.en: Maybe, now that you mention it.^00But it feels like just the right size for us.

records.jp: ま、それもそうだね
records.en_original: Yeah, that's true.
records.en: Yeah, that's true.

records.jp: 伶那さん、ここにはよく来るの？
records.en_original: Do you come here often, Rena?
records.en: Do you come here often, Rena-san?

records.en_original: Well, sometimes. When I want to look up at the sky.
records.en: Well, sometimes. When I want to look up at the sky.

records.jp: おー、なんかロマンチック
records.en_original: Ooh, that sounds so romantic.
records.en: Ooh, that sounds so romantic.

records.jp: こっちの階は静かでいいね
records.en_original: This floor is nice and quiet.
records.en: This floor is nice and quiet.

records.jp: 夜はちょっと不気味だけどね。^00トイレ行く時とか、わりと怖いし
records.en_original: It feels strange at night, though. Going to the bathroom can be a bit scary.
records.en: It feels strange at night, though.^00Going to the bathroom can be a bit scary.

records.jp: ……ちょっと、変なこと言わないでよ
records.en_original: Stop it... Don't say things like that.
records.en: Stop it... Don't say things like that.

records.jp: 伶那さんは釣りとか好き？　私が来る前は^00魚とか獲ったりしてたんでしょ？
records.en_original: Do you like fishing, Rena? You used to catch fish before I came, right?
records.en: Do you like fishing, Rena-san?^00You used to catch fish before I came, right?

records.jp: 苦手。待ってるのが耐えられない
records.en_original: I'm not a fan. I can't stand all the waiting.
records.en: I'm not a fan. I can't stand all the waiting.

records.jp: あー、なんか想像通りかも
records.en_original: Ah, that makes sense.
records.en: Ah, that makes sense.

records.jp: こうやって並んで歩いてると、^00一緒に下校する学生っぽくない？
records.en_original: Walking side-by-side like this, we look like students leaving school together.
records.en: Walking side-by-side like this,^00we look like students leaving school together.

records.jp: 下校できたら良かったのにね
records.en_original: It would be nice if we actually could leave the school.
records.en: It would be nice if we actually could leave the school.

records.jp: 現実を突きつけないで……
records.en_original: You don't have to be such a realist all the time...
records.en: You don't have to be such a realist all the time...

records.jp: 伶那さん、なんか飲む？
records.en_original: You want something to drink, Rena?
records.en: You want something to drink, Rena-san?

records.jp: いい。のど渇いてないし。^00……星崎さんが飲みたいなら、待ってるけど
records.en_original: No, I'm not thirsty. But if you want something, I can wait.
records.en: No, I'm not thirsty.^00But if you want something, Hoshizaki-san, I'll wait.

records.jp: いや、いいや。いこいこ
records.en_original: Nah, it's fine. Let's go.
records.en: Nah, it's fine. Let's go.

records.jp: ここにある薬とか、包帯とか……。^00使ってたらそのうち無くなるよね
records.en_original: If we use up the medicine and bandages we have here, they'll be gone for good, right...?
records.en: If we use up the medicine and bandages we have here,^00they'll be gone for good, right...?

records.jp: その時は自分たちで作ったりするしか^00ないよねえ
records.en_original: If that happens, we can just make our own.
records.en: If that happens,^00we can just make our own.

records.jp: できるだけ使わずに済むのが^00一番だけどね
records.en_original: It might be best to use them as sparingly as possible.
records.en: It might be best to use them as sparingly^00as possible.

records.jp: ……ここの図書室、ちょっとジャンルが^00偏ってる感じしない？
records.en_original: Don't you think the genres of the books in this library have a certain slant?
records.en: Don't you think the genres of the books in this^00library have a certain slant?

records.jp: あー、それは思った。^00なんというか……サブカル系多いよね
records.en_original: Ah, yeah, I noticed that too. There's a lot of...niche literature.
records.en: Ah, yeah, I noticed that too.^00There is a lot of subculture stuff here.

records.jp: ま、別にいいんだけど……
records.en_original: Not that I'm complaining...
records.en: Not that I'm complaining...

records.jp: わっ！！
records.en_original: AAH!!
records.en: AAH!!

records.jp: ちょ、何！？　いきなり大声出さないでよ
records.en_original: Hey, what's wrong with you?! Don't yell like that all of a sudden!
records.en: Hey, what's wrong with you?! Don't yell like that all of a sudden!

records.jp: ごめんごめん。^00いい感じに声が響きそうだったからつい
records.en_original: Sorry! I just thought the acoustics here seemed really good.
records.en: Sorry!^00I just thought the acoustics here seemed really good.

records.jp: う、蒸し暑……
records.en_original: Ugh, it's so muggy...
records.en: Ugh, it's so muggy...

records.jp: プールの真横にあるからねー。^00換気換気っ
records.en_original: We are right next to the pool. Let's get some airflow in here...
records.en: We're right next to the pool.^00Let's get some airflow in here...

records.jp: 湿気で髪ハネてないかな……
records.en_original: I hope the humidity doesn't make my hair frizzy...
records.en: I hope the humidity doesn't make my hair frizzy...

records.jp: 結構汚れが多いですね、この廊下
records.en_original: This hallway is quite dirty...
records.en: This hallway is quite dirty...

records.jp: まあ、みんな靴のまま歩いてるしね。^00一応掃除はしてるんだけど……
records.en_original: Well, we all walk through here with our shoes on. We do clean it, though...
records.en: Well, we all walk through here with our shoes on.^00We do clean it, though...

records.jp: 一度、しっかり隅々まで掃除しましょう
records.en_original: Let's give it a deep clean and get all the nooks and crannies.
records.en: Let's give it a deep clean and get all the nooks and crannies.

records.jp: っとと……風が
records.en_original: Whoa... This wind...
records.en: Whoa... This wind...

records.jp: だいじょぶ？^00落ちたらケガじゃ済まないよ
records.en_original: Are you okay? If you fall, you'll be done for.
records.en: Are you okay?^00If you fall, you'll be done for.

records.jp: 結構高いですもんね……。^00気を付けます
records.en_original: We are quite high up... I'll be careful.
records.en: We're pretty high up...^00I'll be careful.

records.jp: こっちの階、使ってない部屋も^00いくつかあるみたいですけど……
records.en_original: There seem to be a few unused rooms on this floor...
records.en: There seem to be a few^00unused rooms on this floor...

records.jp: そうだね。使ってないというか、^00入れない部屋もあるけど
records.en_original: Yeah. Not so much unused as impossible to get into.
records.en: Yeah. Not so much unused as^00impossible to get into.

records.jp: 中はどうなってるんでしょう。^00……掃除しがいがありそうです
records.en_original: I wonder what they're like inside. ...I bet they'd need a good cleaning.
records.en: I wonder what they're like inside.^00...I bet they'd need a good cleaning.

records.en_original: This place looks like a fishing spot.
records.en: This place looks like a fishing spot.

records.jp: 一応釣りもできるみたいだよ。^00詩帆さんもチャレンジしてみる？
records.en_original: Supposedly it is! Wanna give it a try, Shiho?
records.en: Apparently you can fish here too.^00Wanna give it a try, Shiho-san?

records.en: No... I'd probably be terrible at fishing.^00I'll stick to the cooking.

records.jp: 門の外は……
records.en_original: Outside the gate is...
records.en: Outside the gate is...

records.jp: 見ての通り、ずっと水に覆われてる
records.en_original: Yep, it's nothing but water as far as the eye can see.
records.en: Yep, it's nothing but water as far as the eye can see.

records.jp: 閉じ込められてるんだ、っていうことを^00実感させられますね……
records.en_original: It really drives home the feeling of being trapped, doesn't it...?
records.en: It really drives home the feeling of being trapped,^00doesn't it...?

records.jp: ここの自販機コーナー、^00外の景色も見えて結構いい雰囲気ですね
records.en_original: This vending machine area has a nice view of the outside. I like it here.
records.en: This vending machine area has a nice view of the outside.^00I like it here.

records.jp: ちょっと一息つくのにちょうどいいよね
records.en_original: It's the perfect place to collect your thoughts.
records.en: It's the perfect place to collect your thoughts.

records.jp: いっそ、テーブルなんかも置いて^00もっとくつげるようにしても……
records.en_original: Maybe we could put a table here to make it even more comfortable...
records.en: Maybe we could put a table here to^00make it even more comfortable...

records.jp: ここにある机、置いてある書類を見ても^00保健室の先生のものだと思うんですけど……
records.en_original: It looks like this desk and the papers on it belong to the school nurse, but...
records.en: It looks like this desk and the papers^00on it belong to the school nurse, but...

records.jp: この世界には先生っていませんよね。^00ちょっと不気味じゃないですか……？
records.en_original: There are no teachers in this world, are there? Isn't that strange...?
records.en: There are no teachers in this world, are there?^00Isn't that strange...?

records.jp: 確かに……。持ち主はどこに……^00いや、最初からいないのかな
records.en_original: You're right... I wonder where the owner is. Maybe there never even was one...
records.en: You're right... I wonder where the owner is.^00Maybe there never even was one...

records.jp: この図書室、料理関係の本が^00結構たくさんありますよね
records.en_original: This library has quite a lot of cookbooks.
records.en: This library has quite^00a lot of cookbooks.

records.jp: 言われてみれば、確かにそんな気がする
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, it totally does.
records.en: Now that you mention it, it totally does.

records.jp: 学校の図書室にしては珍しいですけど……^00献立の参考になるので助かります
records.en_original: It is odd that they're in a school library, but they've helped me a lot.
records.en: It's odd that they're in a school library,^00but they've helped me a lot.

records.jp: 広い体育館にわたしたちだけだと、^00ちょっと寂しいですね
records.en_original: It feels a bit lonely when we're the only ones in this big gym.
records.en: It feels a bit lonely when we're the only^00ones in this big gym.

records.jp: まあ、その分存分に使えるからね。^00全面使って遊び放題！
records.en_original: But that means we have the place all to ourselves to do what we like!
records.en: But that means we have the place all to^00ourselves to do what we like!

records.jp: ふふ、そうですね
records.en_original: Hehe, you're right.
records.en: Hehe, you're right.

records.jp: 洗濯はいつも^00星崎さんが担当してるんですか？
records.en_original: Are you always in charge of the laundry, Ao?
records.en: Are you always in^00charge of the laundry, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: まあね。なんもしないわけにもいかないし。^00料理とかは詩帆さんたちに任せた方が良いし
records.en_original: I've gotta do something around here, and it's probably best if I leave the cooking to you.
records.en: Well, I have to do something around here.^00And it's probably best to leave the cooking to Shiho-san and the others.

records.jp: そこは適材適所で！
records.en_original: I think we're both in the right place!
records.en: The right person for the right job!

records.jp: よーし、廊下の端っこまで競争だ！
records.en_original: All right, let's race to the end of the hallway!
records.en: All right, let's race to the end of the hallway!

records.jp: また伶那さんに怒られるよー
records.en_original: Rena'll get mad at us.
records.en: Rena-san'll get mad at us.

records.jp: そう言いながら^00愛央も走る気まんまんじゃない？
records.en_original: You say that, but you look like you're raring to go!
records.en: You say that,^00but you look like you're raring to go!

records.jp: やっほー！！！
records.en_original: ECHOOOO!
records.en: ECHOOOO!

records.jp: そんな、山じゃないんだから。^00反響するものもなんもないし
records.en_original: We're not in the mountains. There's nothing for your voice to echo off of.
records.en: We're not in the mountains.^00There's nothing for your voice to echo off of.

records.jp: いやー、でも高いところに登ったら^00叫びたくなっちゃうでしょ
records.en_original: Doesn't climbing someplace high just make you wanna shout, though?
records.en: Doesn't climbing someplace high just^00make you wanna shout, though?

records.en_original: Not many people come to this floor, so we can run all we want! How smart am I?!
records.en: Not many people come to this floor,^00so we can run all we want! How smart am I?!

records.jp: なんでそんなに走りたがるの……
records.en_original: Why do you always want to run so bad...?
records.en: Why do you always want to run so bad...?

records.jp: やっぱ長い通路を見たら走りたくなるのが^00人のサガってやつじゃん
records.en_original: Just seeing a long corridor makes me want to run down it. Must be human nature.
records.en: Just seeing a long corridor makes me want to run down it.^00Must be human nature.

records.en_original: Did you use to go fishing here before I came?
records.en: Did you use to^00go fishing here before I came?

records.en_original: Yeah, but I never really caught anything. I just sat here getting impatient.
records.en: Yeah, but I never really caught anything.^00I just sat here getting impatient.

records.en_original: One time I almost dove in to grab the fish myself, but the others stopped me.
records.en: One time I almost dove in to grab the fish myself,^00but the others stopped me.

records.en_original: There's this big tree here, but I've never seen a single leaf on the ground.
records.en: There's this big tree here, but I've never seen a^00single leaf on the ground.

records.jp: ふふん。あたしが定期的に掃除してるからね
records.en_original: Hehe. That's because I clean this area up regularly.
records.en: Hehe. That's because I clean this area up regularly.

records.jp: そうだったの！？^00へえ、意外とマメだなあ……
records.en_original: Really?! I would never have guessed it was you...
records.en: Really?!^00I would never have guessed it was you...

records.jp: 意外ってどういうこと！
records.en_original: What's that supposed to mean?!
records.en: What's that supposed to mean?!

records.en_original: What do you usually drink, Yuki?
records.en: What do you usually drink, Yuki?

records.jp: いろいろ。たぶんこの自販機にあるやつは^00全部飲んだよ
records.en_original: This and that. I've probably had everything this vending machine sells.
records.en: This and that. I've probably had everything this vending^00machine sells.

records.jp: へえー。今度おすすめ教えてよ
records.en_original: Oh really? Next time you'll have to recommend something.
records.en: Oh really? Next time you'll have to recommend something.

records.jp: ここに来るとやっぱちょっと落ち着くなー
records.en_original: Coming here always helps me relax.
records.en: Coming here always helps me relax.

records.jp: その感覚、イマイチわかんないんだよねえ。^00私は逆に緊張しちゃう
records.en_original: I might never understand that feeling. If anything, I get nervous.
records.en: I might never understand that feeling.^00If anything, I get nervous.

records.jp: まあ、わかんなくてもいい感覚かもねー……
records.en_original: Well, it's probably fine for you not to understand...
records.en: Well, it's probably fine for you not to understand...

records.en_original: There's a lot of manga here. That means even I can enjoy the library!
records.en: There's a lot of manga here.^00That means even I can enjoy the library!

records.en_original: Why don't you try reading a novel sometime?
records.en: Why don't you try reading a novel sometime?

records.jp: いやー、眠くなっちゃうからパス
records.en_original: Nah, they just put me to sleep. I'll pass.
records.en: Nah, they just put me to sleep. I'll pass.

records.en_original: Besides sports, did they do ceremonies and stuff in the gym too at your school?
records.en: Besides sports, did they do ceremonies^00and stuff in the gym too at your school?

records.en_original: Yeah. I hated going to those. Such a waste of time...
records.en: Yeah. I hated going to those. Such a waste of time...

records.en: By the way, there seem to be a^00few rooms we don't use...

records.jp: そもそも入れないところもあるからねー
records.en_original: Yeah, there were a few places we weren't able to get into.
records.en: Yeah, there were a few places we weren't able to get into.

records.jp: 開かずの教室、ってことね
records.en_original: The forbidden classrooms, you mean.
records.en: The forbidden classrooms, you mean.

records.jp: なんかそう言われると途端に^00学校の怪談っぽくなってくるね……
records.en_original: It sounds scary when you say it like that...
records.en: It sounds scary when^00you say it like that...

records.jp: ここにボートでも浮かんでいたら、^00いいデートスポットになりそうね
records.en_original: This would be a great date spot if there was a boat.
records.en: This would be a great date^00spot if there was a boat.

records.jp: まあ、うっかり沖に流されたら^00戻ってこれなくなりそうだけど
records.en_original: But if we got swept out to sea we might not be able to get back.
records.en: But if we got swept out to sea we^00might not be able to get back.

records.jp: さらっと怖い事言わないで……
records.en_original: Stop, that's scary...
records.en: Stop, that's scary...

records.jp: ここに植えてある木も、^00季節が来れば花が咲くのかしら
records.en_original: I wonder if this tree will bloom when the season comes.
records.en: I wonder if this tree will^00bloom when the season comes.

records.jp: 一向に夏が終わる気配はないけどね……
records.en_original: It doesn't look like summer will ever end, though.
records.en: It doesn't look like summer will ever end, though.

records.jp: ええ、涼しい季節が恋しいわね……
records.en_original: True. I miss the cooler seasons...
records.en: True. I miss the cooler seasons...

records.jp: 美弦さん、何か飲む？
records.en_original: Want something to drink, Mio?
records.en: Want something to drink, Mio-san?

records.jp: そうね。何かおすすめはある？
records.en_original: Sure. What do you recommend?
records.en: Sure. What do you recommend?

records.jp: んー、私は牛乳とかよく飲むかなあ。^00後は炭酸飲料に紅茶に……どれも美味しいよ
records.en_original: Hmm, I guess I usually drink milk. I also like soda, tea... Everything's good!
records.en: Hmm, I guess I usually drink milk.^00I also like soda, tea... Everything's good!

records.jp: 美弦さんってなんか保健室が似合うよね。^00保健室の先生っぽいっていうか
records.en_original: You kinda look like you're in your element here, Mio. You remind me of a nurse.
records.en: You kinda look like you're in your element here, Mio-san.^00You remind me of a nurse.

records.jp: そんなに年取ってるように見える？
records.en_original: Do I really look that old to you?
records.en: Do I really look that old to you?

records.jp: そ、そういう意味じゃないって！^00優しそうってこと！
records.en_original: Th-that's not what I'm saying! I just meant because you're so kind and caring!
records.en: Th-that's not what I'm saying!^00I just meant because you're so kind and caring!

records.jp: 冗談よ。ありがとね
records.en_original: I'm joking. Thanks.
records.en: I'm joking. Thanks.

records.jp: 美弦さんって漫画とかラノベとかも^00読んだりするの？
records.en_original: Do you ever read manga or YA novels, Mio?
records.en: Do you ever read manga or YA novels,^00Mio-san?

records.jp: あまりそういうのは読まないわね。^00面白いのかしら？
records.en_original: Not so much, no. Are they any good?
records.en: Not so much, no.^00Are they any good?

records.jp: 面白いのもいっぱいあるよー。^00今度おすすめ紹介するね！
records.en_original: There are lots of good ones! I can recommend some to you next time!
records.en: There are lots of good ones!^00I can recommend some to you next time!

records.jp: 美弦さんって運動は得意な方？
records.en_original: Are you good at sports, Mio?
records.en: Are you good at sports, Mio-san?

records.jp: 可もなく不可もなく、かしらね
records.en_original: Not great, not terrible, I suppose.
records.en: Not great, not terrible, I suppose.

records.jp: 陽桜莉に付き合わされて、^00昔から体を動かすことは多かったけど
records.en_original: Hiori always used to drag me along, so I got plenty of exercise growing up.
records.en: Hiori always used to drag me along,^00so I got plenty of exercise growing up.

records.jp: あー、それはなんか想像できる
records.en_original: Ah, that's not hard to imagine.
records.en: Ah, that's not hard to imagine.

records.jp: 美弦さんの髪、長いのにさらさらだよねー。^00手入れとか大変じゃない？
records.en_original: Your hair is so long and smooth, Mio. Isn't it hard to take care of?
records.en: Your hair is so long and smooth, Mio-san.^00Isn't it hard to take care of?

records.jp: そんなに特別なことはしていないわよ。^00生まれつきの髪質なのかしらね
records.en_original: I don't do anything special to it. Maybe I was born with it.
records.en: I don't do anything special to it.^00Maybe I was born with it.

records.jp: うらやましい～！
records.en_original: Lucky...
records.en: Lucky...

records.jp: この廊下は飲食禁止なのか。^00立札にそう書いてあった
records.en_original: Are food and drinks forbidden in the hallway? There was a sign that said so.
records.en: Are food and drinks forbidden in the hallway?^00There was a sign that said so.

records.jp: それ、私たちが自主的に置いたものじゃ^00ないんだけどね。何となくみんな守ってる
records.en_original: We didn't hang that up ourselves, but everyone seems to follow it.
records.en: We didn't hang that up ourselves,^00but everyone seems to follow it.

records.jp: まあ、ルールとはだいたいそういうもの。^00最後には守ることだけが目的になる
records.en_original: Well, that is the sole purpose of rules. They are made to be followed.
records.en: Well, that's how rules tend to be.^00Eventually, following them becomes the whole point.

records.jp: なかなか深いな……
records.en_original: So deep...
records.en: So deep...

records.jp: 風が気持ちいい……
records.en_original: This breeze feels nice...
records.en: This breeze feels nice...

records.jp: 風に飛ばされて落ちないでよ。^00きらら、軽そうだし
records.en_original: Don't get blown away, Kirara. You seem pretty light.
records.en: Don't get blown away, Kirara.^00You seem pretty light.

records.jp: 心配しなくていい。きららくらいになれば、^00風を味方につけて空を舞うことだってできる
records.en_original: You don't need to worry about me. I could just harness the wind and fly away.
records.en: You don't need to worry about Kirara.^00At Kirara's level, she could harness the wind and soar through the sky.

records.jp: 学校の廊下といえば、人体模型が走ったり^00足だけの幽霊が目撃されることで有名……
records.en_original: I thought school hallways were well-known spots for supernatural sightings.
records.en: I thought school hallways were well-known^00spots for supernatural sightings.

records.jp: そういう話はないの？
records.en_original: Ghosts with only legs, anatomical models coming to life and running around, things like that. No?
records.en: Ghosts with only legs, anatomical models coming to life and running around, things like that. No?

records.jp: そんなありふれてるみたいに言われても……^00残念ながらないなあ
records.en_original: It almost sounds normal when you say it... But no, I'm afraid not.
records.en: It almost sounds normal when you say it...^00But no, I'm afraid not.

records.jp: まるで釣り場みたいだ
records.en_original: This is like a fishing spot.
records.en: This is like a fishing spot.

records.jp: きららは釣りとかやったことある？
records.en_original: Have you ever been fishing, Kirara?
records.en: Have you ever been fishing, Kirara?

records.jp: ない。でもちょっと興味はある……
records.en_original: Never. I have always been curious about it, though.
records.en: Never. I have always been curious about it, though.

records.jp: もしここが本当の学校なら……^00ボートで登校することになるんだろうか
records.en_original: If this were a real school, I wonder if we'd have to commute by boat.
records.en: If this were a real school,^00I wonder if we'd have to commute by boat.

records.jp: 始業開始間際とか大変そうだね。^00ボートが渋滞起こしちゃって
records.en_original: That'd be a nightmare in the mornings. All the boats would cause a traffic jam.
records.en: That'd be a nightmare in the mornings.^00All the boats would cause a traffic jam.

records.jp: 朝からパニック不可避……
records.en_original: There is no escape from the morning rush...
records.en: There is no escape from the morning rush...

records.jp: ここの自販機はなかなか品揃えがいい。^00業者のセンスを感じる
records.en_original: This vending machine has a decent selection. The owner has good taste.
records.en: This vending machine has a decent selection.^00The owner has good taste.

records.jp: 業者……っていうか、多分みんなの要望が^00形になったものなんだと思うよ
records.en_original: Is there an owner...? I thought it was just made from everyone's desires.
records.en: Is there an owner...?^00I thought it was just made from everyone's desires.

records.jp: なるほど……^00それなら好みの商品が多いのも納得
records.en_original: I see... That would explain why it has so many things I like.
records.en: I see...^00That would explain why it has so many things I like.

records.jp: きらら、保健室の空気感は結構好き。^00静かで、落ち着く
records.en_original: I quite like the atmosphere of the nurse's office. It's quiet and calming.
records.en: Kirara rather likes the atmosphere of the nurse's office.^00It's quiet and calming.

records.jp: 私は結構緊張しちゃうんだよねえ。^00薬品っぽいにおいとか、真っ白なベッドとか
records.en_original: It makes me feel nervous. The bleach-white bedsheets, the smell of medicine...
records.en: It makes me feel nervous.^00The bleach-white bedsheets, the smell of medicine...

records.jp: そこは慣れ。^00りらーっくす、りらーっくす
records.en_original: You'll get used to it. Relax... Relax...
records.en: You'll get used to it.^00Relax... Relax...

records.jp: 図書室の本に数字のシールが貼ってあるけど^00あれってどういう意味があるんだろう
records.en_original: Library books all have stickers with numbers on them. I wonder what they're for.
records.en: Library books all have stickers with numbers on them.^00I wonder what they're for.

records.jp: あれは本の分類を表してる。^00いわゆる十進分類法というヤツ
records.en_original: It shows how the books should be organized. It's called the Dewey Decimal System.
records.en: It shows how the books should be organized.^00It's called the Dewey Decimal System.

records.jp: へえ、きらら詳しいね
records.en_original: Wow, you really know your stuff, Kirara.
records.en: Wow, you really know your stuff, Kirara.

records.jp: う、蒸し暑い……
records.en_original: Ugh, it's so muggy...
records.en: Ugh, it's so muggy...

records.jp: 熱がこもるよねー……
records.en_original: It feels like the heat is trapped in here...
records.en: It feels like the heat is trapped in here...

records.jp: 用がないなら、早く出よう。早く
records.en_original: Let us leave this place at once. There's nothing we need here anyway.
records.en: Let us leave this place at once. There's nothing we need here anyway.

records.jp: きららの髪って地毛？^00それともパーマかけてる？
records.en_original: Is that your natural hair, Kirara? Or did you get it permed?
records.en: Is that your natural hair, Kirara?^00Or did you get it permed?

records.jp: これは生まれつき。……変かな？
records.en_original: I was born with this hair. ...Is it weird?
records.en: I was born with this hair. ...Is it weird?

records.jp: いや、かわいいと思うよ。^00私もパーマかけようかなあ
records.en_original: No, I think it's cute. Maybe I should get a perm.
records.en: No, I think it's cute.^00Maybe I should get a perm.

records.jp: いい感じの布だ！^00なんか衣装とか作れたりしないかな？
records.en_original: This is a really nice fabric! I wonder if we could make an outfit or something with it?
records.en: This is a really nice fabric!^00I wonder if we could make an outfit or something with it?

records.jp: 衣装って……^00星崎さんはなんか作ったことあるの？
records.en_original: An outfit? Have you ever made something like that, Ao?
records.en: An outfit?^00Have you ever made something like that, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: いやぁ……ないんだけど^00でもちょっとやってみたいよね
records.en_original: Not that I can think of... But I wanna give it a try.
records.en: Not that I can think of...^00But I wanna give it a try.

records.jp: 布の素材だね。昔は布が貴重で^00よく再利用とかしていたんだって
records.en_original: It's a fabric. Back in the day, fabric was so valuable, people had to reuse it.
records.en: It's a fabric. Back in the day,^00fabric was so valuable, people had to reuse it.

records.jp: 布ですね。^00ソーイングセットはあったので、補修ならお任せください
records.en_original: It's fabric. I have a sewing kit, so if you need anything mended, let me know.
records.en: It's fabric.^00I have a sewing kit, so if you need anything mended, let me know.

records.jp: 綺麗な色だね。^00色々な材料に使えそう。
records.en_original: What a pretty color. This could be a useful material for a lot of things.
records.en: What a pretty color.^00This could be a useful material for a lot of things.

records.jp: カラフルだね。そういえば学校に虹ってかかるのかな
records.en_original: It's so colorful. I wonder if rainbows exist in this world.
records.en: It's so colorful. I wonder if rainbows exist in this world.

records.jp: どうだろう……今度探してみようかな
records.en_original: I don't know... We'll have to keep an eye out.
records.en: I don't know... We'll have to keep an eye out.

records.jp: ガラスは尖っていることもあるから気を付けて^00触るときは慎重に……
records.en_original: Glass can be very sharp even when it doesn't look it, be careful when touching it...
records.en: Glass can be very sharp even when it doesn't look it,^00be careful when touching it...

records.jp: ガラスって綺麗だよね
records.en_original: Glass sure can be pretty, huh?
records.en: Glass sure can be pretty, huh?

records.jp: 確かに！小さい頃はガラス玉とか集めたなぁ
records.en_original: Definitely! I used to collect little glass marbles when I was little.
records.en: Definitely! I used to collect little glass marbles when I was little.

records.jp: 窓を割って侵入するシーン、実はちょっと真似したい
records.en_original: I've always wanted to try breaking in somewhere through a window, just like in the movies...
records.en: I've always wanted to try breaking in somewhere through a window, just like in the movies...

records.jp: け、ケガはしないようにね……？
records.en_original: D-don't hurt yourself...!
records.en: D-don't hurt yourself...!

records.jp: お、重い……！^00でもいっぱい集めなきゃ……！
records.en_original: Oof, it's heavy...! But we need to gather all we can...!
records.en: Oof, it's heavy...!^00But we need to gather all we can...!

records.jp: 金属って地味に値段が高かったりするよね
records.en_original: Metal can be pretty expensive.
records.en: Metal can be pretty expensive.

records.jp: これももしかして売ったら高かったり……！
records.en_original: I wonder if we could get a lot for this...?!
records.en: I wonder if we could get a lot for this...?!

records.jp: 金属ですね。^00丈夫ですし、色々なものに使えそうです。
records.en_original: Metal. It's strong, so we can use it for a lot of things.
records.en: Metal.^00It's strong, so we can use it for a lot of things.

records.jp: すぐ燃えるから^00保管場所には気を付けなきゃ
records.en_original: It burns easily, so be careful where you store it.
records.en: It burns easily,^00so be careful where you store it.

records.jp: 学校が火事になったら大変だよね。^00消防車とかこないだろうし。
records.en_original: We don't want the school burning down. I doubt any firefighters would show up.
records.en: We don't want the school burning down.^00I doubt any firefighters would show up.

records.jp: 燃料として使えるものです。^00といっても、学校にはIHがあるんですよね。
records.en_original: We can be used as fuel. The school already has an induction stove, though.
records.en: We can be used as fuel.^00The school already has an induction stove, though.

records.jp: 便利な時代になったよね
records.en_original: We really do live in an age of convenience.
records.en: We really do live in an age of convenience.

records.jp: よし、採れた！
records.en_original: Look what I found!
records.en: Look what I found!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、危ないからそんなに振り回さないで！
records.en_original: Don't swing it around, Hiori. Its dangerous.
records.en: Don't swing it around, Hiori-san. Its dangerous.

records.jp: 甘いもの！　体重とか心配だけど、別腹別腹
records.en_original: Sweets! I really shouldn't, but they just taste so good!
records.en: Sweets! I really shouldn't, but they just taste so good!

records.jp: 星崎さん、保健室に体重計あるんだけど……
records.en_original: There's a scale in the nurse's office, you know, Ao...
records.en: There's a scale in the nurse's office, you know, Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: や、やっぱりやめておこうかな……
records.en_original: M-maybe I won't...
records.en: M-maybe I won't...

records.jp: 甘い食材だね。そのままでもいいし、お菓子にしても美味しいよ
records.en_original: Sweet ingredients. We can eat it as is or make some yummy confections.
records.en: Sweet ingredients. We can eat it as is or make some yummy confections.

records.jp: 今度新作のケーキを作るので^00よかったら感想聞かせてください
records.en_original: I'm going to test out a new cake recipe. You'll have to tell me how it tastes.
records.en: I'm going to test out a new cake recipe.^00You'll have to tell me how it tastes.

records.jp: おいしそうなものみっけ！^00お姉ちゃんにも食べてもらいたいな～
records.en_original: This looks yummy! I want Mio to have some too!
records.en: Found something tasty!^00I want Onee-chan to try some too!

records.jp: すっぱいものって体に良さそうな気がするね。^00でもあんまり得意じゃなかったり……
records.en_original: Sour things usually aren't very good for you. I'm not actually a big fan of them anyways...
records.en: Sour things usually aren't very good for you.^00I'm not actually a big fan of them anyways...

records.jp: 星崎さんには大人の味が分からないか……
records.en_original: You've still got a child's palate...
records.en: I guess you don't understand adult tastes yet, Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: ちょっと味見を……
records.en_original: Let's have a taste...
records.en: Let's have a taste...

records.jp: あ、陽桜莉さん、それは……
records.en_original: Ah, Hiori, that's...
records.en: Ah, Hiori-san, that's...

records.jp: なにこれ……すっぱーい！
records.en_original: What is this?! It's so sour!
records.en: What is this?! It's so sour!

records.jp: 酸味のある食べ物ですね。^00酸味は料理の味を調えてくれるので重宝してます。
records.en_original: It's sour ingredients. The sourness completes the flavor profile of many dishes, so it's very important.
records.en: It's sour ingredients.^00Their acidity helps balance a dish, so I find them very useful.

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃんの料理、今日もたのしみだなぁ
records.en_original: I can't wait to see what you cook up today, Shiho.
records.en: I can't wait to see what you cook up today, Shiho-chan.

records.jp: 目に入るとしみるんだよね^00慎重に……　慎重に……
records.en_original: Careful... Careful... It'll sting if it gets in your eyes.
records.en: Careful... Careful...^00It'll sting if it gets in your eyes.

records.jp: 勇希が作業室を地獄にしたことがあったよね^00あれだけは繰り返してはいけない
records.en_original: Yuki managed to turn the work room into a hell-hole that one time. We can't let that happen again.
records.en: Yuki managed to turn the work room into a hell-hole that one time.^00We can't let that happen again.

records.jp: 辛い物を食べると体があたたまるよね。^00……今は夏だけど
records.en_original: Spicy food warms you up. It's already so hot today, though...
records.en: Spicy food warms you up.^00It's already so hot today, though...

records.jp: でもいい汗かけて食べた後は涼しいよ！^00私は夏でも全然食べたいな～
records.en_original: But working up a sweat while eating makes you feel cool afterwards! I love spicy food during summer!
records.en: But working up a sweat while eating makes you feel cool afterwards!^00I love spicy food during summer!

records.jp: 料理するときは辛いのが苦手な人でも食べれるようにしています。^00私自身、得意じゃないですし
records.en_original: I always try to cook food that people can enjoy even if they don't like spicy stuff. I'm not a big fan of it myself.
records.en: I try to make dishes even people who dislike spicy food can enjoy.^00I'm not fond of it myself.

records.jp: なんだか神秘的な力を感じる……。^00きららに見せてみようかな
records.en_original: I can feel some kind of mystical energy... I'll have to show this to Kirara.
records.en: I can feel some kind of mystical energy...^00I'll have to show this to Kirara.

records.jp: たしかに！^00きららちゃんなら何か感じてそう！
records.en_original: Good idea! Kirara will definitely feel something!
records.en: Good idea!^00Kirara-chan will definitely feel something!

records.jp: これを使って占いとかできないかな？
records.en_original: I wonder if this can be used for fortune telling or something?
records.en: I wonder if this can be used for fortune telling or something?

records.jp: 占いかぁ……一時期流行ったなぁ^00やり方全然覚えてないけど
records.en_original: Fortune telling... It was really popular for a while, but I don't remember how to do it at all...
records.en: Fortune telling... It was really popular for a while,^00but I don't remember how to do it at all...

records.jp: 今度図書室で調べてみよっか！
records.en_original: Let's see if we can't find any books about it in the library!
records.en: Let's see if we can't find any books about it in the library!

records.jp: これは身体に良さそうだね。^00病気とか吹き飛んじゃいそう
records.en_original: This looks like it'd be good for your health. I bet it would help you get over a cold like that.
records.en: This looks like it'd be good for your health.^00I bet it would help you get over a cold like that.

records.jp: 眠気も一緒に吹き飛ぶよ！^00……睡眠不足で逆に不健康になったりしそう
records.en_original: Or give you an energy boost! Though gotta be careful not to take it too late and lose sleep...
records.en: Or give you an energy boost!^00Though gotta be careful not to take it too late and lose sleep...

records.jp: 栄養源としては優秀ですけど味は……^00料理の腕が試されますね！
records.en_original: This is an excellent source of nutrition, but the taste is, well... This is going to put my cooking skills to the test!
records.en: This is an excellent source of nutrition, but the taste is, well...^00This is going to put my cooking skills to the test!

records.jp: これは…複雑な工作に使えるかも！
records.en_original: We could use this to craft some pretty complicated things!
records.en: We could use this to craft some pretty complicated things!

records.en_original: I bet we could use that demon's cape thing to hide if we took it.
records.en: I bet we could use that monster's^00cape thing to hide if we took it.

records.jp: ナイスアイディア！^00頼んだ勇希
records.en_original: Good idea! We'll wait here while you do that.
records.en: Good idea!^00We'll wait here while you do that.

records.jp: や、やだなあ。冗談だってば
records.en_original: C-come on, I was just joking...
records.en: C-come on, I was just joking...

records.jp: モンスターがバッチリ見張ってるー……
records.en_original: The demons are on the lookout...
records.en: The monsters are on the lookout...

records.jp: タイミング合わせて後ろに回り込んでいこう
records.en_original: Let's try to get by behind them.
records.en: Let's try to get by behind them.

records.jp: この橋を通ると目立っちゃいそうだね
records.en_original: We'll be easy to spot while we cross this bridge.
records.en: We'll be easy to spot while we cross this bridge.

records.jp: 敵が見てないうちにさっさと渡っちゃお！
records.en_original: Let's try to cross when the enemy isn't watching!
records.en: Let's try to cross when the enemy isn't watching!

records.jp: うう、道が細くて歩きづらい……
records.en_original: It's so narrow...
records.en: It's so narrow...

records.jp: うまく物陰に隠れられればいいんだけど
records.en_original: If only there was something we could hide behind...
records.en: If only there was something we could hide behind...

records.jp: このおっきな箱^00隠れるのにちょうどよさそうだね
records.en_original: What about this big box? I bet we could use this to hide.
records.en: What about this big box?^00I bet we could use this to hide.

records.jp: いっそ箱ごと引きずっていけば……って^00かえって目立っちゃうか
records.en_original: I think we'd probably stand out more dragging a box around with us...
records.en: I think we'd probably stand out more dragging^00a box around with us...

records.jp: この先にも敵、いるのかなあ
records.en_original: I wonder if there are demons up ahead.
records.en: I wonder if there are enemies up ahead.

records.jp: 慎重に進もうね
records.en_original: Let's be careful.
records.en: Let's be careful.

records.jp: 腕が疲れそうだなあ
records.en_original: I bet this is gonna be exhausting.
records.en: I bet this is gonna be exhausting.

records.jp: ふー……何とか切り抜けたー！
records.en_original: Phew... We made it out!
records.en: Phew... We made it out!

records.jp: 次はあのトラックの向こうを探してみよう
records.en_original: Let's see if there's anything behind that truck.
records.en: Let's see if there's anything behind that truck.

records.jp: 見つからないように^00そーっとそーっと……
records.en_original: Careful... Careful... Don't let them see you...
records.en: Careful... Careful...^00Don't let them see you...

records.jp: 障害物をうまく利用していこう
records.en_original: Let's use these obstacles to our benefit.
records.en: Let's use these obstacles to our benefit.

records.jp: この辺は敵が少ないね。ラッキー
records.en_original: There aren't many baddies around here. Awesome.
records.en: There aren't many baddies around here. Awesome.

records.jp: 油断しないでよ。いきなり物陰から^00飛び出してくるかもしれないんだから
records.en_original: Don't let your guard down. You never know when something might appear.
records.en: Don't let your guard down.^00You never know when something might appear.

records.jp: よし……あと半分くらいかな？
records.en_original: I think we're about half way through.
records.en: I think we're about half way through.

records.jp: 最後まで気を抜かずに行かないとね！
records.en_original: Keep focused until the end!
records.en: Keep focused until the end!

records.jp: もしこれを渡っている最中に^00見つかったら……
records.en_original: If they see us while we're crossing...
records.en: If they see us while we're^00crossing...

records.jp: そうならないよう気を付けよう……
records.en_original: Let's be careful and make sure that doesn't happen.
records.en: Let's be careful and make sure that doesn't happen.

records.jp: なんかヤバそうなのいるんですけど！？
records.en_original: What is that thing?!
records.en: What is that thing?!

records.jp: スリル満点って感じだね……
records.en_original: I guess we won't be wanting for thrills...
records.en: I guess we won't be wanting for thrills...

records.jp: またいるー！
records.en_original: There's another one!
records.en: There's another one!

records.jp: ゴールまであと少し……！^00もうひと頑張り！
records.en_original: Just a little bit further! We can do this!
records.en: Just a little bit further!^00We can do this!

records.jp: 灯籠の前を見張っているモンスターが……
records.en_original: Demons are patrolling in front of the lanterns...
records.en: Monsters are patrolling in front of the lanterns...

records.jp: 後ろに回り込んだら何とかならないかな？
records.en_original: Maybe we'll be okay if we just go around?
records.en: Maybe we'll be okay if we just go around?

records.jp: 降りる時も慎重にいかないとね
records.en_original: We'll have to be careful while we make our way down.
records.en: We'll have to be careful while we make our way down.

records.jp: 降りてる最中に見つかったら^00一たまりもないですもんね……
records.en_original: We don't stand a chance if they find us before we make it down...
records.en: We don't stand a chance if they^00find us before we make it down...

records.jp: ふう……あと少しで着くと思ったら、^00少し緊張してきました
records.en_original: Phew... Just a little further. I'm starting to feel a little nervous.
records.en: Phew... Just a little further.^00I'm starting to feel a little nervous.

records.jp: あはは。あとちょっとだから頑張ろう
records.en_original: Ahaha. We can do this.
records.en: Ahaha. We can do this.

records.jp: 敵に見つからないようにするには……
records.en_original: How can we avoid being seen...
records.en: How can we avoid being seen...

records.jp: とにかく群れを避けて^00外側を通るしかないかな
records.en_original: Our only choice may to avoid the groups of demons and work our way around the edge.
records.en: I guess we'll have to avoid the groups^00and work our way around the edge.

records.jp: 愛央、任せたよ！
records.en_original: Good luck, Ao!
records.en: Good luck, Ao!

records.jp: なんかドキドキしてきた……！
records.en_original: I'm feeling kinda nervous all of a sudden...!
records.en: I'm feeling kinda nervous all of a sudden...!

records.jp: よーし、あともうちょい！
records.en_original: All right, just a little further!
records.en: All right, just a little further!

records.jp: 静かにっ！
records.en_original: Quiet!
records.en: Quiet!

records.jp: ちょ、伶那さんもっ
records.en_original: That goes for you too.
records.en: H-hey, you too, Rena-san!

records.jp: 幸い、身を隠せそうな^00障害物がありますね
records.en_original: Luckily, we have something to hide ourselves behind.
records.en: Luckily,^00we have something to hide ourselves behind.

records.jp: あれに隠れながら進もっか。^00忍者みたいに！
records.en_original: We can use that to ninja our way over!
records.en: We can use that to ninja^00our way over!

records.jp: やはり私、足手まといではないでしょうか
records.en_original: I hope I'm not a burden.
records.en: I hope I'm not a burden.

records.jp: いやいや、全然。^00むしろ、私より隠れるの上手くない……？
records.en_original: No, not at all! If anything, you're even better at hiding than I am...
records.en: No, not at all!^00If anything, you're even better at hiding than I am...

records.jp: 向こうの足場にも敵がいますね
records.en_original: There are enemies over there as well.
records.en: There are enemies over there as well.

records.jp: タイミングよく行かないと見つかっちゃうね
records.en_original: We'll have to time this well if we don't want to get spotted.
records.en: We'll have to time this well if we don't want to get spotted.

records.jp: 美弦さん、何か見つけたー？
records.en_original: Find anything, Mio?
records.en: Find anything, Mio-san?

records.jp: 今のところは全然ね。愛央の方こそ、^00よそ見して敵に見つからないようにね
records.en_original: Nothing yet. Be careful not to let the demons find you.
records.en: Nothing yet.^00Be careful not to let the enemies find you.

records.jp: ……なんかヤバそうなのいない？
records.en_original: ...That thing looks crazy.
records.en: ...That thing looks crazy.

records.jp: ……見つかったら大変ね。^00物陰に隠れながら進みましょう
records.en_original: We certainly don't want to be found by that. Let's move behind these obstacles.
records.en: We certainly don't want to be found by that.^00Let's move behind these obstacles.

records.jp: あっちの方はまだ探してないよね
records.en_original: We haven't looked over there yet.
records.en: We haven't looked over there yet.

records.jp: レシピ完成まであともう少し。^00気を引き締めていきましょう
records.en_original: I've almost completed the recipe. Just a bit more.
records.en: I've almost completed the recipe.^00Just a bit more.

records.jp: 階段の鳥居のとこ、^00ばっちりマークされちゃってるなあ
records.en_original: The gates on the stairs are totally covered.
records.en: The gates on the^00stairs are totally covered.

records.jp: 上に行くには遠回りしなくてはならなそうだ
records.en_original: We'll have to go around if we want to get up them.
records.en: We'll have to go around if we want to get up them.

records.jp: この先にも気配がある……
records.en_original: I feel a presence further in...
records.en: I feel a presence further in...

records.jp: 慎重に進もう……
records.en_original: Let's be careful.
records.en: Let's be careful.

records.jp: よし、切り抜けた！
records.en_original: We made it!
records.en: We made it!

records.jp: あっちだ、急ごう！^00……と言いたいが、慎重に慎重に
records.en_original: Over there! Follow me! ...Is what I'd like to say, but we should be careful.
records.en: Over there! Follow me!^00...Is what I'd like to say, but we should be careful.

records.jp: 油断大敵！
records.en_original: Nothing more dangerous than carelessness!
records.en: Nothing more dangerous than carelessness!

records.jp: 体から何かがあふれ出しています……！
records.en_original: Something is coming out of its body...?
records.en: Something is overflowing from its body...!

records.jp: まだ力を隠してたってこと……！？
records.en_original: It still wasn't using its full strength?!
records.en: It still wasn't using its full strength?!

records.jp: 注意だ！　きっと、より強力な攻撃が来る！
records.en_original: Careful! Its next attack will be extremely powerful!
records.en: Watch out! A much more powerful attack is coming!

records.jp: さあ……私たちの意地を見せてやろう！
records.en_original: Let's show this thing just how stubborn we can be!
records.en: Now... let's show them what we're made of!

records.jp: こんな箱みたいなのに^00負けるわけにはいかないもんね！
records.en_original: There's no way we can lose against this box!
records.en: There's no way we^00can lose against this box!

records.jp: 油断しないで！^00きっと一筋縄じゃいかない
records.en_original: Don't let your guard down! I have a feeling this won't be easy.
records.en: Don't let your guard down!^00I have a feeling this won't be easy.

records.jp: こんな形だからこそ、何をしてくるかわかりません。気を付けて！
records.en_original: It might have some hidden tricks. Be careful!
records.en: It might have some hidden tricks. Be careful!

records.jp: 今のって……
records.en_original: What was that just now?
records.en: What was that just now?

records.jp: 私たちの記憶？　^00頭の中に直接響いてきたよね……
records.en_original: Was it our memories? It felt like it echoed right in my head...
records.en: Was it our memories?^00It felt like it echoed right in my head...

records.jp: そういえばこんなことも……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, that sounds familiar...
records.en: Now that you mention it, that sounds familiar...

records.jp: あったよね！　都ちゃんからいろいろ言われたっけ
records.en_original: Yeah, it sure does! Miyako scolded me a bunch back then.
records.en: Yeah, it sure does! Miyako-chan scolded me a bunch back then.

records.jp: 結局私たちは違うことばかりだったけど……
records.en_original: In the end, we only found more differences between us, but...
records.en: In the end, we only found more differences between us, but...

records.jp: 違うからこその強さもあるんだよね！
records.en_original: But those differences make us strong, too!
records.en: But those differences make us strong, too!

records.jp: これって由紀姫の記憶……？
records.en_original: Are these... Princess Yuki's memories?
records.en: Are these... Princess Yuki's memories?

records.jp: そうみたい。あの子の想いが流れ込んでくる……
records.en_original: I think so. Her feelings are flowing right into me...
records.en: I think so. Her feelings are flowing right into me...

records.jp: あの時は、都ちゃんが大活躍だったね
records.en_original: Back then, Miyako totally saved the day, didn't she?
records.en: Back then, Miyako-chan totally saved the day, didn't she?

records.jp: うん。今も連絡を取り合ってるみたい
records.en_original: Yeah. I hear they still keep in contact, too.
records.en: Yeah. I hear they still keep in contact, too.

records.jp: これは……陽桜莉と美弦さんの記憶、よね？
records.en_original: This is... a memory of yours with Mio, right?
records.en: This is... a memory of yours with Mio-san, right?

records.jp: うん。七夕の日の、大切な思い出……
records.en_original: Yeah. A precious memory from Tanabata...
records.en: Yeah. A precious memory from Tanabata...

records.jp: 前の世界でも、^00お姉ちゃんとモモさんはバディだったんだよね
records.en_original: Even in the previous world, your sister and Momo were close, right?
records.en: Even in the previous world,^00Onee-chan and Momo-san were partners, right?

records.jp: だから二人は今の世界でも、共鳴したんだと思う
records.en_original: That's why I think they resonated in this world, too.
records.en: That's why I think they resonated in this world, too.

records.jp: 前の世界の瑠夏ちゃんはどんな瑠夏ちゃんだったのかな
records.en_original: I wonder what Ruka was like in the previous world.
records.en: I wonder what Ruka-chan was like in the previous world.

records.jp: きっと、今じゃ考えられないくらい、一人だったかも
records.en_original: Maybe she was even more lonely than we can imagine now.
records.en: Maybe she was even more lonely than we can imagine now.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんたちが負けちゃったのは私のせいだ……。^00だから、前に進まなくちゃ
records.en_original: My sister and the others lost because of me... That's why I have to move forward.
records.en: My sister and the others lost because of me...^00That's why I have to move forward.

records.jp: 陽桜莉……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: 今度は瑠夏ちゃんと亜未琉さんの記憶だったね
records.en_original: This time, it was a memory of yours and Amiru, huh?
records.en: This time, it was a memory of Ruka-chan and Amiru-san.

records.jp: うん。想いを捨ててしまっても、それでも^00彼女は涼楓さんのことを想ってた……
records.en_original: Yeah. Even after giving up her feelings, she still... cared about Ryoka.
records.en: Yeah. Even after giving up her feelings,^00she still... cared about Ryoka-san.

records.jp: 二人とも、苦しんでた。^00お互いの想いに気付けずに、^00傷つけあって……
records.en_original: They were both suffering. Hurting each other and never realizing how the other felt...
records.en: They were both suffering.^00Hurting each other and never realizing^00how the other felt...

records.jp: だから、私たちがなんとかしないと
records.en_original: That's why we have to do something.
records.en: That's why we have to do something.

records.jp: 都ちゃん、すごいね……
records.en_original: Miyako, you're amazing...
records.en: Miyako-chan, you're amazing...

records.jp: 見ちゃいけないものを見ちゃったような……
records.en_original: Feels like I just saw something I really shouldn't have...
records.en: Feels like I just saw something I really shouldn't have...

records.jp: ツナマヨおにぎりのパワー恐るべし、だったよね……
records.en_original: The power of the tuna-mayo rice ball is honestly terrifying, isn't it?
records.en: The power of the tuna-mayo onigiri is honestly terrifying, isn't it?

records.jp: 流石は白樺さんというか……
records.en_original: As expected of Miyako, I guess...
records.en: That's Shirakaba-san for you, I guess...

records.jp: 散らばってた欠片はこれで全部みたいだね！
records.en_original: Looks like that's all the scattered shards!
records.en: Looks like that's all the scattered shards!

records.jp: うん。^00きっとこの記憶たちも、二人の背中を押してくれるはず
records.en_original: Yeah. I'm sure these memories will give the two of them the push they need.
records.en: Yeah.^00I'm sure these memories will give the two of them the push they need.

records.jp: 陽桜莉ちゃん、瑠夏ちゃん。^00どうか、この世界を守って……！
records.en_original: Hiori, Ruka. Please, protect this world!
records.en: Hiori-chan, Ruka-chan.^00Please, protect this world!

records.jp: 異灰の出現を感知した。^00至急、１０５地区へ向かってくれ
records.en_original: I've detected a Testa outbreak. Head to District 105 immediately.
records.en: I've detected a Testa outbreak.^00Head to District 105 immediately.

records.jp: リーダーさん、相談したいことがあるんです。^00後でわたしのところへ来てもらえますか？
records.en_original: Leader, there's something I want to talk to you about. Could you come see me later?
records.en: Leader-san, there's something I'd like to discuss.^00Could you come see me later?

records.jp: ミッション成功のためには、もっと情報が必要だ。^00司令に相談してみるのがよさそうだ
records.en_original: We'll need more intel if we want to succeed. Maybe it's time to consult the commander.
records.en: We'll need more intel if we want to succeed.^00Maybe it's time to consult the commander.

records.jp: リーダー、勉強会の準備ができたから^00後で文芸部室に来てもらえる？
records.en_original: Leader, we finished setting up for the study session. Could you come to the literature club room later?
records.en: Leader, we finished setting up for the study session.^00Could you come to the literature club room later?

records.jp: 異灰の出現を感知した。^00準備ができ次第、４３地区へ向かってくれ
records.en_original: We've detected Testa. Head to District 43 once you're ready.
records.en: We've detected Testa.^00Head to District 43 once you're ready.

records.jp: ＡＡＳＡから戦闘指導員が派遣されてきた。^00後ほど、司令室に来てくれ
records.en_original: A combat instructor has been sent from AASA. Please come to the command room later.
records.en: A combat instructor has been sent from AASA.^00Please come to the command room later.

records.jp: リーダー、すまないが司令室へ来てくれ。^00紹介したい奴がいるんでな
records.en_original: Sorry, Leader, but could you come to the command room? There's someone I want to introduce.
records.en: Sorry, Leader, but could you come to the command room?^00There's someone I want to introduce.

records.jp: みんなに相談？^00なら、文芸部室で聞くから来てもらえる？
records.en_original: You want to talk to everyone? In that case, I'll be in the literature club room—could you come there?
records.en: You want to talk to everyone?^00In that case, I'll be in the literature club room—could you come there?

records.jp: 遠征作戦の詳細について確認した。^00準備ができ次第、直ちに出動してくれ
records.en_original: I've checked the details of the expedition. Move out as soon as you're ready.
records.en: I've checked the details of the expedition.^00Move out as soon as you're ready.

records.jp: 差出人不明で『屋上へ来て』と送られてきた。^00誰かのイタズラだろうか……？
records.en_original: I got a message from an unknown sender saying "Come to the rooftop." Is this some kind of prank?
records.en: I got a message from an unknown sender saying "Come^00to the rooftop." Is this some kind of prank?

records.jp: ２年Ａ組の春日詩帆。^00至急、指導室まで来るように
records.en_original: Shiho Kasuga from 2-A. Please come to the counselor's office immediately.
records.en: Kasuga Shiho from 2-A.^00Please come to the counselor's office immediately.

records.jp: 広島校の部隊の新人が訪ねてくるそうだ。^00後ほど、司令室に来てくれ
records.en_original: A new recruit from the Hiroshima Academy unit is coming by for a visit. Come to the command room later.
records.en: A new recruit from the Hiroshima Academy unit is coming by for a visit.^00Come to the command room later.

records.jp: 次の作戦についてのミーティング？^00わかった、あとで文芸部室に集まろう
records.en_original: A meeting about the next operation? Got it, let's meet in the literature club room later.
records.en: A meeting about the next operation?^00Got it, let's meet in the literature club room later.

records.jp: 新たな遠征作戦の詳細について確認した。^00入念に準備したうえで、出動してくれ
records.en_original: I've checked the details of the new expedition mission. Make sure you're prepared before you head out.
records.en: I've checked the details of the new expedition mission.^00Make sure you're prepared before you head out.

records.jp: さっきのかんなは、どこか元気がなさそうに見えた。^00様子を見に行った方がいいかもしれない
records.en_original: Kanna seemed a bit down earlier. Maybe I should go check on her.
records.en: Kanna seemed a bit down earlier.^00Maybe I should go check on her.

records.jp: みんな、後で部室に集まってもらえる？^00私の心配し過ぎならいいんだけど……
records.en_original: Everyone, could you gather in the club room later? Maybe I'm just being paranoid, but...
records.en: Everyone, could you gather in the club room later?^00Maybe I'm just being paranoid, but...

records.jp: 最後の休息だ。^00悔いのないように過ごそう
records.en_original: This is our last break. I should make sure I don't have any regrets.
records.en: This is our last break.^00Let's make sure we have no regrets.

records.jp: 陽桜莉ちゃん、瑠夏ちゃん、こっちだよ！
records.en_original: Hiori, Ruka, over here!
records.en: Hiori-chan, Ruka-chan, over here!

records.jp: どんな形であれ、想いは大切なもの……^00お願い、迎えに行ってあげて
records.en_original: No matter what form they take, feelings are precious... Please, go and bring them back.
records.en: No matter what form they take, feelings are precious...^00Please, go and bring them back.

records.jp: もしもーし、誰か聞こえる？^00陽桜莉ー、羽成さーん、モモさーん、いるー？^00誰でもいいから、電話出てくれない？
records.en_original: Hellooo, can anyone hear me? Hiori? Ruka, Momo, are you there? Pick up the phone, please! Anyone?
records.en: Hellooo, can anyone hear^00me? Hiori? Ruka, Momo, are you there?^00Pick up the phone, please! Anyone?

records.jp: パイプオルガンの音……これも、誰かの想い？
records.en_original: I hear a pipe organ... Is that the manifestations of someone's feelings too?
records.en: I hear a pipe organ... Is that a manifestation of someone's feelings too?

records.jp: 今度は誰の想いなんだか……
records.en_original: Whose feelings is it this time?
records.en: Whose feelings is it this time?

records.jp: あれは、文庫本かな？^00何の本だろう
records.en_original: Is that a paperback? I wonder what book it is.
records.en: Is that a paperback?^00I wonder what book it is.

records.jp: バイロン、って書いてあるみたいだけど、^00私も聞いたことない
records.en_original: It looks like it says "Byron" on it, but I've never heard of him either.
records.en: It looks like it says "Byron" on it,^00but I've never heard of him either.

records.jp: すべては終焉を迎えた　愛しい人^00光と夢　喜びの声
records.en_original: "'Tis done!—I saw it in my dreams. No more with Hope the future beams.
records.en: "'Tis done!—I saw it in my dreams.^00No more with Hope the future beams.

records.jp: さようなら　いいえ^00思い出すら「さようなら」と叫びたがる
records.en_original: Love Hope, and Joy, alike adieu! Would I could add Remembrance too!"
records.en: Love Hope,^00and Joy, alike adieu! Would I could add Remembrance too!"

records.jp: あれって、涼楓さんたちのプレイヤーだ
records.en_original: That's the player Ryoka and the others have.
records.en: That's the player Ryoka-san and the others have.

records.jp: じゃあ、あれは涼楓さんたちの……
records.en_original: So then that must be Ryoka and...
records.en: So then that must be Ryoka-san and...

records.jp: モモさんとお姉ちゃんの声が聞こえる！
records.en_original: I can hear the voices of Momo and my sister!
records.en: I can hear the voices of Momo-san and Onee-chan!

records.jp: うん。行ってみよう
records.en_original: It sounds like it's coming from that glowing orb over there. Let's check it out.
records.en: Yeah. Let's go check it out.

records.jp: あのもや、なんだろう……。^00ただのもやって感じでもなさそうだし
records.en_original: What's that mist? It doesn't seem like it's any ordinary fog.
records.en: What's that mist?^00It doesn't seem like it's any ordinary fog.

records.jp: 見に行ってみよう。^00もしかしたら、誰かの想いかも
records.en_original: Let's go take a look. Maybe it has something to do with someone's emotions.
records.en: Let's go take a look.^00Maybe it has something to do with someone's emotions.

records.jp: これが紫乃の深層心理。^00燃えたぎる怒りそのもの……
records.en_original: This is Shino's deepest psyche. It's pure blazing anger...
records.en: This is Shino's deepest psyche.^00It's pure blazing anger...

records.jp: 会いたければ、これを乗り越えて来いってこと……^00なんだよね？
records.en_original: If we want to see her, we have to get through this... That's what that means, right?
records.en: If we want to see her, we have to get through this...^00That's what that means, right?

records.jp: 陽桜莉、やり残したことはない？^00溶岩に飛び込んだら、多分後戻りできないと思う
records.en_original: Hiori, are you sure you don't have anything left to do? Once we jump in, I don't think we'll be able to come back.
records.en: Hiori, are you sure you don't have anything left to do?^00Once we jump in, I don't think we'll be able to come back.

records.jp: 大丈夫だと思うけど、一応確認してみる
records.en_original: I think I'm set, but I'll double-check just in case.
records.en: I think I'm set, but I'll double-check just in case.
